name: DIN Meter Signal K display
summary: Signal K values on a small DIN-rail display in the switch panel
description: Firmware for the M5Stack DIN Meter: one or two Signal K values per page, set up in the device's web page, with the knob to turn to the next page. Unit conversions from Signal K's SI units, stale and wrong-type values marked, night brightness from environment.mode, a dark mode for night watches and buzzer tunes. Reads from Signal K only; no server plugin needed.
